title: TikTok Shop US fulfillment operational guidance

statements.text: Use the order type, fulfillment method, current order status, and the target dates shown in Seller Center when assessing a fulfillment question. This guidance does not determine the live status of an individual order.
no_answer_when: the fulfillment method cannot be established

statements.text: Operational responsibility and timing can differ between TikTok Shipping, Seller Shipping, and Fulfilled by TikTok. If the applicable method or current platform instruction cannot be verified, provide the official source link and escalate for manual review.
no_answer_when: the current instruction cannot be verified

statements.text: Tracking information should be accurate and traceable. Carrier scans, delivery events, breach findings, compensation eligibility, and promised delivery outcomes must come from an authorized live business source rather than this static guidance.
no_answer_when: the request asks for a carrier scan or delivery event
the request asks for a breach or compensation decision
